usage: 孔雀 is a noun that refers to a specific type of bird known for its colorful feathers.
You can use 孔雀 as the subject or object of a sentence when talking about this bird.
When describing a 孔雀, you can mention its distinctive tail or its bright colors.
孔雀 is often seen as a symbol of beauty or pride in Cantonese culture.
